paragraphs: Rabbi Bisna, in Acha’s name, Re'eh Rabbah; Jerusalem Yevamot 3; Chiyya’s, Tanchuma Shemini. Bisna and Rav Chanan bar Abba in Rav’s name, Jerusalem Avodah Zarah 1. In Yehoshua ben Levi’s name, Jerusalem Ha'ishah Shehalakh; Yose bar Chanina’s, Bammeh Tomnin; La’s, beginning of Mashkin; Layya’s, Jerusalem Shabbat 2; Meir’s, Bereshit Rabbah 15.
